title: Map (Hub)
wikitext: {{About|a map of Hub Island located on the side of {{Zone|Community Center}} in the {{Zone|Village}}|other uses|Map}} The '''Map''', also called '''Hub Map''', is a location on the [[Hub Island]] that shows all [[Public Islands]]. It is located on the front wall of the {{Zone|Community Center}}. == Map Revisions == {| class="wikitable" ! Image!! Map Revision On !! Description |- | [[File:Hub Map (Old).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|0.1}} || The first map of Public Islands. Added [[Hub Island]], [[Floating Islands]], [[Spider's Den]], [[Blazing Fortress]], [[Gold Mine]], [[Deep Caverns]], [[The Barn]], and [[Mushroom Desert]]. |- | [[File:Hub Map (Second).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|2020/February 28}} || The second map of Public Islands. Replaced [[Floating Islands]] with [[The Park]], and added [[The End]]. |- | [[File:Hub Map (0.8.1).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|0.8.1}} || The third map of Public Islands with major changes to the [[Hub Island]]. |- | [[File:Dante MSG.jpg|220px]] || April 7, 2021 || The Hub Map temporarily replaced by a message from [[Dante]]. |- | [[File:Seraphine MSG.png|220px]] || April 16, 2021 || The Hub Map temporarily replaced by a message from [[Seraphine]]. |- | [[File:Hub Map (0.11.4).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|0.11.4}} || The fourth map of Public Islands with major changes to the [[Mushroom Desert]] and the [[Spider's Den]]. |- | [[File:Hub Map (AF2022).png|220px]] || April 1, 2022; yearly thereafter || The Hub Map was temporarily replaced on [[April Fools]] day. |- | [[File:Hub Map (0.13).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|0.13}} || The fifth map of Public Islands. Replaced [[Blazing Fortress]] with [[Crimson Isle]]. |- | [[File:Hub Map (0.23).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|0.23}} || The sixth map of Public Islands. Revamped [[The Park]] and added [[Galatea]]. |- | [[File:Hub Map (0.24.2).png|220px]] || {{Changelog|0.24.2}} || The seventh map of Public Islands. Revamped alongside the Hub Island revamp. |} == Trivia == * The Map consists of a 13x7 grid of 91 small [[mcw:map|Minecraft Maps]] in item frames. These item frames are placed on [[Sea Lantern|Sea Lanterns]] which keep the map grid bright and easy to see. * For the second, third and fourth maps, [[Launch Pad (structure)|Launch Pad]]s are marked on the map with semi-visible thin lines. This was changed when the 5th map established clear logos for Slime Launcher locations and directions. * The second and third maps featured text above the islands indicating the location names. * Historically, the Map is only replaced when major appearance changes happen on any public island. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.1|Added the Hub World Map}} {{History|2020/Feb 28|Updated the Hub World Map to show new locations}} {{History|0.8.1|Updated the Hub World Map to be consistent with the reconstruction of the [[Village]]|The Hub Map was moved from near {{NPCSprite|Duke}} and {{NPCSprite|Lynn}} in the village, to the front wall of the {{Zone|Community Center}}.}} {{History|2021/April 7|link=none|The Hub World Map was replaced by a message from [[Dante]]}} {{History|2021/April 16|link=none|The Hub World Map was replaced by a message from [[Seraphine]]}} {{History|2021/April 21|Updated the map to show [[The Farming Islands]] update}} {{History|0.13|Updated the map to show the Nether Update, replacing [[Blazing Fortress]] with [[Crimson Isle]]}} {{History|0.23|Updated the map to show the Foraging Update, revamping [[The Park]] and adding [[Galatea]].}} {{History|0.24.2|Revamped the map with the release of the 1.21 [[Hub]].}} }} [[Category:Village]]
